title: The Cover of Tashkent
author: Orsen Nakamura
blurb: Gideon Thornbury, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
